section.div: Favorites genres: Comedy, Action, Fantasy, Romance

div.div:
A mind game of lies and deceit begins! At Academy Island, students battle in Games to win stars, hoping to earn the prestigious title “Seven Star.” Sarasa is last year’s champion and is on track to win again until Hiroto, a new transfer student, hits the scene. Surprisingly, Hiroto defeats her by sheer luck! Now, he must use bluffs and trickery to stay on top.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

The students of class 3-E have a mission: kill their teacher before graduation. He has already destroyed the moon, and has promised to destroy the Earth if he can not be killed within a year. But how can this class of misfits kill a tentacled monster, capable of reaching Mach 20 speed, who may be the best teacher any of them have ever had?

A mind game of lies and deceit begins! At Academy Island, students battle in Games to win stars, hoping to earn the prestigious title “Seven Star.” Sarasa is last year’s champion and is on track to win again until Hiroto, a new transfer student, hits the scene. Surprisingly, Hiroto defeats her by sheer luck! Now, he must use bluffs and trickery to stay on top.
(Source: Crunchyroll)
Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru
Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, Slice of Life

High schooler Wakana Gojou cares about one thing: making Hina dolls. With nobody to share his obsession, he has trouble finding friends—or even holding conversation. But after the school’s most popular girl, Marin Kitagawa, reveals a secret of her own, he discovers a new purpose for his sewing skills. Together, they’ll make her cosplay dreams come true!
(Source: Funimation)

Friendship vs. love...!? A love-triangle romantic comedy about being caught between two princesses!! Shunsuke and Hinaki are childhood friends who entered high school together. They've always been good friends, but their new classmates mistake them for lovers?
(Source: Weekly Shounen Champion, translated)

Hanta Date is a normal guy, except he's a little short. He has a girlfriend. Her poker face and taciturn nature may seem cold at first glance. But she is actually very sweet to Hanta...! The more he gets to know her, the sweeter she becomes, and the more he feels overwhelmed!
(Source: Magapoke, translated)
